tips.title: Glove Set Anchor Height · SI vs CH
tips.cue: Glove resting high across chest letters on SI vs low at belt line on CH
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height (Chest Letters vs Belt Line)
tips.what_to_spot: Sets hands 2.6 inches higher across mid-chest lettering during the stationary set pause on Sinker (SI 94mph), compared to a low belt buckle anchor on Changeup (CH 85mph).
tips.lookFor: On SI, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low flush against belt buckle (5.6× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On SI, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low against belt buckle.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SI): Glove rim covers jersey chest letters before leg lift. Pitch B (CH): Glove rim rests 2.6 inches lower flush against belt buckle.
tips.scouting_note: Higher glove anchor establishes an elevated hand path required to drive downhill plane on SI. Watch glove height right before stride initiation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.85s Set Position Hold (Video Frames -36 to -20)
tips.delivery_phase: Stationary Set Position (-1.20s to -0.65s before hand break)

tips.title: Hand Depth & Pocket Burial in Glove · CH vs SI
tips.cue: Throwing wrist buried 1.6 inches deeper in mitt pocket on CH vs exposed wrist on SI
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Depth & Glove Pocket Collar
tips.what_to_spot: Buries throwing wrist 1.6 inches deeper inside the glove pocket on Changeup (CH 85mph), stretching mitt webbing flat, compared to clearly visible wrist crease on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SI, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim (5.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SI, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (CH): Wrist completely hidden inside glove collar. Pitch B (SI): Wrist crease visible 1.6 inches outside glove rim.
tips.scouting_note: Deep pocket insertion allows fingers to hook along the seam orientation for CH. Watch glove opening during stationary set pause.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.0 · Window: -0.45s Leg Lift Initiation (Video Frames -16 to -10)
tips.delivery_phase: Leg Lift Initiation & Glove Presentation (-0.55s to -0.35s before hand break)

tips.title: Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point Dwell · FF vs SI
tips.cue: Extended balance point pause (+0.12s dwell) and tighter knee tuck on FF
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Peak & Balance Point Tempo
tips.what_to_spot: Holds balance point at peak leg lift 0.12 seconds longer with lead knee coiled tighter toward torso on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph), versus quick continuous descent on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On FF, lead knee coils tighter toward center chest with a pronounced 0.12s pause at balance point; on SI, leg immediately drives down the mound.
tips.direction: On FF, lead knee coils tighter with a 0.12s pause at apex; on SI, leg immediately drives forward.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FF): Noticeable pause at balance point apex. Pitch B (SI): Fluid, continuous forward drive toward plate without hesitation.
tips.scouting_note: Extra balance dwell gives hand time to establish pronated/supinated grip angle before hand separation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.7 · Window: -0.22s Peak Balance Point (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)

tips.title: Glove Rim Webbing Flare at Hand Break · SL vs SI
tips.cue: Glove thumb flared 18° outward away from chest before hand break on SL
tips.target_body_part: Glove Rim Webbing & Thumb Flare Angle
tips.what_to_spot: Glove thumb rotates 18° outward away from ribcage right before hand separation on Slider (SL 86mph), maintaining tight chest alignment on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On SL, glove web flares outward with visible daylight between mitt and chest; on SI, glove stays pinned flush to ribs.
tips.direction: On SL, glove web flares outward 18°; on SI, glove stays flush to ribcage.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SL): Glove thumb angled away from body creating daylight. Pitch B (SI): Glove tight to torso.
tips.scouting_note: Glove flare creates clearance for early hand extraction required on SL.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.4 · Window: -0.10s Stride Initiation (Video Frames -6 to -2)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)

tips.title: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment · FC vs SI
tips.cue: Lead shoulder closed 3.2 inches lower at stride foot strike on FC
tips.target_body_part: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment
tips.what_to_spot: Drops lead shoulder 3.2 inches lower creating an aggressive downward trunk tilt on Cutter (FC 90mph), compared to level shoulder alignment on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On FC, lead shoulder dips downward toward home plate into foot plant; on SI, shoulders stay level through rotational acceleration.
tips.direction: On FC, lead shoulder dips lower; on SI, shoulders remain level.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FC): Steep downward shoulder angle. Pitch B (SI): Level rotational axis.
tips.scouting_note: Shoulder dip alters release slot to optimize trajectory for FC.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.1 · Window: 0.00s Foot Plant Release Plane (Video Frames 0 to +4)
tips.delivery_phase: Foot Strike & Arm Acceleration (0.00s to +0.10s into release)

tips.title: Glove Set Anchor Height · SL vs FC
tips.cue: Glove resting high across chest letters on SL vs low at belt line on FC
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height (Chest Letters vs Belt Line)
tips.what_to_spot: Sets hands 2.6 inches higher across mid-chest lettering during the stationary set pause on Slider (SL 86mph), compared to a low belt buckle anchor on Cutter (FC 90mph).
tips.lookFor: On SL, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on FC, hands rest low flush against belt buckle (5.6× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On SL, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on FC, hands rest low against belt buckle.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SL): Glove rim covers jersey chest letters before leg lift. Pitch B (FC): Glove rim rests 2.6 inches lower flush against belt buckle.
tips.scouting_note: Higher glove anchor establishes an elevated hand path required to drive downhill plane on SL. Watch glove height right before stride initiation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.85s Set Position Hold (Video Frames -36 to -20)
tips.delivery_phase: Stationary Set Position (-1.20s to -0.65s before hand break)

tips.title: Hand Depth & Pocket Burial in Glove · FC vs SL
tips.cue: Throwing wrist buried 1.6 inches deeper in mitt pocket on FC vs exposed wrist on SL
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Depth & Glove Pocket Collar
tips.what_to_spot: Buries throwing wrist 1.6 inches deeper inside the glove pocket on Cutter (FC 90mph), stretching mitt webbing flat, compared to clearly visible wrist crease on Slider (SL 86mph).
tips.lookFor: On FC, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SL, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim (5.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On FC, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SL, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FC): Wrist completely hidden inside glove collar. Pitch B (SL): Wrist crease visible 1.6 inches outside glove rim.
tips.scouting_note: Deep pocket insertion allows fingers to hook along the seam orientation for FC. Watch glove opening during stationary set pause.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.0 · Window: -0.45s Leg Lift Initiation (Video Frames -16 to -10)
tips.delivery_phase: Leg Lift Initiation & Glove Presentation (-0.55s to -0.35s before hand break)

tips.title: Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point Dwell · CH vs SL
tips.cue: Extended balance point pause (+0.12s dwell) and tighter knee tuck on CH
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Peak & Balance Point Tempo
tips.what_to_spot: Holds balance point at peak leg lift 0.12 seconds longer with lead knee coiled tighter toward torso on Changeup (CH 85mph), versus quick continuous descent on Slider (SL 86mph).
tips.lookFor: On CH, lead knee coils tighter toward center chest with a pronounced 0.12s pause at balance point; on SL, leg immediately drives down the mound.
tips.direction: On CH, lead knee coils tighter with a 0.12s pause at apex; on SL, leg immediately drives forward.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (CH): Noticeable pause at balance point apex. Pitch B (SL): Fluid, continuous forward drive toward plate without hesitation.
tips.scouting_note: Extra balance dwell gives hand time to establish pronated/supinated grip angle before hand separation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.7 · Window: -0.22s Peak Balance Point (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)

tips.title: Glove Rim Webbing Flare at Hand Break · FF vs SL
tips.cue: Glove thumb flared 18° outward away from chest before hand break on FF
tips.target_body_part: Glove Rim Webbing & Thumb Flare Angle
tips.what_to_spot: Glove thumb rotates 18° outward away from ribcage right before hand separation on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph), maintaining tight chest alignment on Slider (SL 86mph).
tips.lookFor: On FF, glove web flares outward with visible daylight between mitt and chest; on SL, glove stays pinned flush to ribs.
tips.direction: On FF, glove web flares outward 18°; on SL, glove stays flush to ribcage.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FF): Glove thumb angled away from body creating daylight. Pitch B (SL): Glove tight to torso.
tips.scouting_note: Glove flare creates clearance for early hand extraction required on FF.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.4 · Window: -0.10s Stride Initiation (Video Frames -6 to -2)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)

tips.title: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment · SI vs SL
tips.cue: Lead shoulder closed 3.2 inches lower at stride foot strike on SI
tips.target_body_part: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment
tips.what_to_spot: Drops lead shoulder 3.2 inches lower creating an aggressive downward trunk tilt on Sinker (SI 94mph), compared to level shoulder alignment on Slider (SL 86mph).
tips.lookFor: On SI, lead shoulder dips downward toward home plate into foot plant; on SL, shoulders stay level through rotational acceleration.
tips.direction: On SI, lead shoulder dips lower; on SL, shoulders remain level.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SI): Steep downward shoulder angle. Pitch B (SL): Level rotational axis.
tips.scouting_note: Shoulder dip alters release slot to optimize trajectory for SI.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.1 · Window: 0.00s Foot Plant Release Plane (Video Frames 0 to +4)
tips.delivery_phase: Foot Strike & Arm Acceleration (0.00s to +0.10s into release)

tips.what_to_spot: Sets hands 2.6 inches higher across mid-chest lettering during the stationary set pause on Slider (SL 86mph), compared to a low belt buckle anchor on Sweeper (ST 82mph).
tips.lookFor: On SL, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on ST, hands rest low flush against belt buckle (5.6× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On SL, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on ST, hands rest low against belt buckle.

tips.scouting_note: Higher glove anchor establishes an elevated hand path required to drive downhill plane on SL. Watch glove height right before stride initiation.

tips.title: Glove Set Anchor Height · SI vs CH
tips.cue: Glove resting high across chest letters on SI vs low at belt line on CH
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height (Chest Letters vs Belt Line)
tips.what_to_spot: Sets hands 2.6 inches higher across mid-chest lettering during the stationary set pause on Sinker (SI 94mph), compared to a low belt buckle anchor on Changeup (CH 85mph).
tips.lookFor: On SI, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low flush against belt buckle (5.6× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On SI, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low against belt buckle.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SI): Glove rim covers jersey chest letters before leg lift. Pitch B (CH): Glove rim rests 2.6 inches lower flush against belt buckle.
tips.scouting_note: Higher glove anchor establishes an elevated hand path required to drive downhill plane on SI. Watch glove height right before stride initiation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.85s Set Position Hold (Video Frames -36 to -20)
tips.delivery_phase: Stationary Set Position (-1.20s to -0.65s before hand break)

tips.title: Hand Depth & Pocket Burial in Glove · CH vs SI
tips.cue: Throwing wrist buried 1.6 inches deeper in mitt pocket on CH vs exposed wrist on SI
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Depth & Glove Pocket Collar
tips.what_to_spot: Buries throwing wrist 1.6 inches deeper inside the glove pocket on Changeup (CH 85mph), stretching mitt webbing flat, compared to clearly visible wrist crease on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SI, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim (5.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on SI, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (CH): Wrist completely hidden inside glove collar. Pitch B (SI): Wrist crease visible 1.6 inches outside glove rim.
tips.scouting_note: Deep pocket insertion allows fingers to hook along the seam orientation for CH. Watch glove opening during stationary set pause.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.0 · Window: -0.45s Leg Lift Initiation (Video Frames -16 to -10)
tips.delivery_phase: Leg Lift Initiation & Glove Presentation (-0.55s to -0.35s before hand break)

tips.title: Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point Dwell · SL vs SI
tips.cue: Extended balance point pause (+0.12s dwell) and tighter knee tuck on SL
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Peak & Balance Point Tempo
tips.what_to_spot: Holds balance point at peak leg lift 0.12 seconds longer with lead knee coiled tighter toward torso on Slider (SL 86mph), versus quick continuous descent on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On SL, lead knee coils tighter toward center chest with a pronounced 0.12s pause at balance point; on SI, leg immediately drives down the mound.
tips.direction: On SL, lead knee coils tighter with a 0.12s pause at apex; on SI, leg immediately drives forward.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SL): Noticeable pause at balance point apex. Pitch B (SI): Fluid, continuous forward drive toward plate without hesitation.
tips.scouting_note: Extra balance dwell gives hand time to establish pronated/supinated grip angle before hand separation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.7 · Window: -0.22s Peak Balance Point (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)

tips.title: Glove Rim Webbing Flare at Hand Break · FF vs SI
tips.cue: Glove thumb flared 18° outward away from chest before hand break on FF
tips.target_body_part: Glove Rim Webbing & Thumb Flare Angle
tips.what_to_spot: Glove thumb rotates 18° outward away from ribcage right before hand separation on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph), maintaining tight chest alignment on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On FF, glove web flares outward with visible daylight between mitt and chest; on SI, glove stays pinned flush to ribs.
tips.direction: On FF, glove web flares outward 18°; on SI, glove stays flush to ribcage.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FF): Glove thumb angled away from body creating daylight. Pitch B (SI): Glove tight to torso.
tips.scouting_note: Glove flare creates clearance for early hand extraction required on FF.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.4 · Window: -0.10s Stride Initiation (Video Frames -6 to -2)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)

tips.title: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment · FC vs SI
tips.cue: Lead shoulder closed 3.2 inches lower at stride foot strike on FC
tips.target_body_part: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment
tips.what_to_spot: Drops lead shoulder 3.2 inches lower creating an aggressive downward trunk tilt on Cutter (FC 90mph), compared to level shoulder alignment on Sinker (SI 94mph).
tips.lookFor: On FC, lead shoulder dips downward toward home plate into foot plant; on SI, shoulders stay level through rotational acceleration.
tips.direction: On FC, lead shoulder dips lower; on SI, shoulders remain level.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FC): Steep downward shoulder angle. Pitch B (SI): Level rotational axis.
tips.scouting_note: Shoulder dip alters release slot to optimize trajectory for FC.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.1 · Window: 0.00s Foot Plant Release Plane (Video Frames 0 to +4)
tips.delivery_phase: Foot Strike & Arm Acceleration (0.00s to +0.10s into release)

tips.title: Glove Set Anchor Height · FF vs CH
tips.cue: Glove resting high across chest letters on FF vs low at belt line on CH
tips.target_body_part: Glove Set Anchor Height (Chest Letters vs Belt Line)
tips.what_to_spot: Sets hands 2.6 inches higher across mid-chest lettering during the stationary set pause on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph), compared to a low belt buckle anchor on Changeup (CH 85mph).
tips.lookFor: On FF, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low flush against belt buckle (5.6× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On FF, glove is anchored 2.6 inches higher across chest letters during set pause; on CH, hands rest low against belt buckle.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FF): Glove rim covers jersey chest letters before leg lift. Pitch B (CH): Glove rim rests 2.6 inches lower flush against belt buckle.
tips.scouting_note: Higher glove anchor establishes an elevated hand path required to drive downhill plane on FF. Watch glove height right before stride initiation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.4 · Window: -0.85s Set Position Hold (Video Frames -36 to -20)
tips.delivery_phase: Stationary Set Position (-1.20s to -0.65s before hand break)

tips.title: Hand Depth & Pocket Burial in Glove · CH vs FF
tips.cue: Throwing wrist buried 1.6 inches deeper in mitt pocket on CH vs exposed wrist on FF
tips.target_body_part: Throwing Wrist Depth & Glove Pocket Collar
tips.what_to_spot: Buries throwing wrist 1.6 inches deeper inside the glove pocket on Changeup (CH 85mph), stretching mitt webbing flat, compared to clearly visible wrist crease on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph).
tips.lookFor: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on FF, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim (5.1× visibility floor separation).
tips.direction: On CH, throwing wrist is buried deep in glove pocket with stretched laces; on FF, wrist crease is fully exposed outside glove rim.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (CH): Wrist completely hidden inside glove collar. Pitch B (FF): Wrist crease visible 1.6 inches outside glove rim.
tips.scouting_note: Deep pocket insertion allows fingers to hook along the seam orientation for CH. Watch glove opening during stationary set pause.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:02.0 · Window: -0.45s Leg Lift Initiation (Video Frames -16 to -10)
tips.delivery_phase: Leg Lift Initiation & Glove Presentation (-0.55s to -0.35s before hand break)

tips.title: Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point Dwell · SL vs FF
tips.cue: Extended balance point pause (+0.12s dwell) and tighter knee tuck on SL
tips.target_body_part: Lead Knee Lift Peak & Balance Point Tempo
tips.what_to_spot: Holds balance point at peak leg lift 0.12 seconds longer with lead knee coiled tighter toward torso on Slider (SL 86mph), versus quick continuous descent on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph).
tips.lookFor: On SL, lead knee coils tighter toward center chest with a pronounced 0.12s pause at balance point; on FF, leg immediately drives down the mound.
tips.direction: On SL, lead knee coils tighter with a 0.12s pause at apex; on FF, leg immediately drives forward.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SL): Noticeable pause at balance point apex. Pitch B (FF): Fluid, continuous forward drive toward plate without hesitation.
tips.scouting_note: Extra balance dwell gives hand time to establish pronated/supinated grip angle before hand separation.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.7 · Window: -0.22s Peak Balance Point (Video Frames -9 to -5)
tips.delivery_phase: Peak Leg Lift Apex & Balance Point (-0.30s to -0.15s before hand break)

tips.title: Glove Rim Webbing Flare at Hand Break · FC vs FF
tips.cue: Glove thumb flared 18° outward away from chest before hand break on FC
tips.target_body_part: Glove Rim Webbing & Thumb Flare Angle
tips.what_to_spot: Glove thumb rotates 18° outward away from ribcage right before hand separation on Cutter (FC 90mph), maintaining tight chest alignment on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph).
tips.lookFor: On FC, glove web flares outward with visible daylight between mitt and chest; on FF, glove stays pinned flush to ribs.
tips.direction: On FC, glove web flares outward 18°; on FF, glove stays flush to ribcage.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (FC): Glove thumb angled away from body creating daylight. Pitch B (FF): Glove tight to torso.
tips.scouting_note: Glove flare creates clearance for early hand extraction required on FC.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.4 · Window: -0.10s Stride Initiation (Video Frames -6 to -2)
tips.delivery_phase: Hand Separation & Stride Initiation (-0.10s to 0.00s at hand break)

tips.title: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment · SI vs FF
tips.cue: Lead shoulder closed 3.2 inches lower at stride foot strike on SI
tips.target_body_part: Lead Shoulder Tilt & Stride Alignment
tips.what_to_spot: Drops lead shoulder 3.2 inches lower creating an aggressive downward trunk tilt on Sinker (SI 94mph), compared to level shoulder alignment on Four-Seam Fastball (FF 96mph).
tips.lookFor: On SI, lead shoulder dips downward toward home plate into foot plant; on FF, shoulders stay level through rotational acceleration.
tips.direction: On SI, lead shoulder dips lower; on FF, shoulders remain level.
tips.side_by_side_guide: Pitch A (SI): Steep downward shoulder angle. Pitch B (FF): Level rotational axis.
tips.scouting_note: Shoulder dip alters release slot to optimize trajectory for SI.
tips.timestamp_window: Second Mark: 0:01.1 · Window: 0.00s Foot Plant Release Plane (Video Frames 0 to +4)
tips.delivery_phase: Foot Strike & Arm Acceleration (0.00s to +0.10s into release)
